CustomField.description: architecture.md Section Q: negative stock is allowed, not blocked - two legitimate offline deductions can each be valid at the moment they happened. This flags a part for manual physical-count reconciliation instead of rejecting the deduction that caused it. Always in sync with Current_Stock__c by construction (a formula, not a maintained field), so there is nothing for PartStockService/the trigger to keep consistent here.
